AnnotationPolicy.description: Ordered construction of authored objects; never renderer-generated copy.
AnnotationPolicy.title: AnnotationPolicy

CalloutBinding.description: Exact authored pointer endpoints; no source or destination inference.
CalloutBinding.title: CalloutBinding

CharacterAssemblyBinding.description: An author's explicit layered character claim, not a generated body/rig.
CharacterAssemblyBinding.title: CharacterAssemblyBinding

ChartPayload.description: Exact external data and display decisions, not an inferred chart recipe.
ChartPayload.title: ChartPayload

CodeSpan.description: Authored text and role; ATME never tokenizes or rewrites this content.
CodeSpan.title: CodeSpan

CompositionBinding.description: Initial receipt; actual complete-layout verification remains mandatory.
CompositionBinding.title: CompositionBinding

CompositionDefinition.description:
Closed authored template, not an executable scene object or runtime rig.

Board/beat/coverage IDs are definition-local context. Later explicit binding
must map that context and every local object ID before ordinary graph paint.
Arrays remain authored content; sibling paint order is still z/ID, not array
order. Definitions contain no nested template references or external clips.
CompositionDefinition.title: CompositionDefinition

CompositionInstanceSpec.description: Explicit authoring input, NOT an executable binding or admission receipt.
CompositionInstanceSpec.title: CompositionInstanceSpec

CompositionParameterSpec.description: All parameters are required at binding; no implicit defaults or expressions.
CompositionParameterSpec.title: CompositionParameterSpec

EvidenceTreatment.description: Exact forensic intent preserved across plan, layout and timing stages.
EvidenceTreatment.title: EvidenceTreatment

IllustrationAssemblyBinding.description: Per-plan authored content identity, not a registry asset or state machine.
IllustrationAssemblyBinding.title: IllustrationAssemblyBinding

ImagePlacement.description: Authored placement of checked supporting pixels, never evidence authority.
ImagePlacement.title: ImagePlacement

MaskContainer.description: Static alpha mask; source is a dedicated sibling, not painted content.
MaskContainer.title: MaskContainer

MediaPlayback.description: One-to-one absolute playback of a checked half-open source interval.
MediaPlayback.title: MediaPlayback

MediaStreamPin.description:
Identity of a checked presentation inventory, not a container/FPS guess.

Raw decoded PTS/durations are sorted in strict presentation order. The
inventory's first PTS is the signed origin and its final PTS+duration is
the exclusive end. The decoder must attest these pins against actual bytes.
MediaStreamPin.title: MediaStreamPin

PointerSourcePoint.description: An authored parent-local source; never inferred from a target anchor.
PointerSourcePoint.title: PointerSourcePoint

RegistryBinding.description: Exact authored anchor names, not inferred art parts or fitted geometry.
RegistryBinding.title: RegistryBinding

StructuredListPayload.description: Authored heading/group/order binding; each item is a real scene object.
StructuredListPayload.title: StructuredListPayload

TechnicalFrameBinding.description: Authored content roles and chrome state; never a lifecycle-state channel.
TechnicalFrameBinding.title: TechnicalFrameBinding
